introduction: Illinois Home Weatherization Assistance Program helps qualifying households improve energy efficiency. Apply through the community action agency serving your area.
description: Illinois Home Weatherization Assistance Program helps qualifying households improve energy efficiency. Apply through the community action agency serving your area.

sections.who: The agency reviews household income and property participation. Illinois also lists qualifying benefit-program enrollment as a possible categorical eligibility route. Use the current IHWAP guidance for your household.
sections.get: Approved work can include air sealing, insulation, heating or water-heater measures and selected health and safety improvements. The assessment determines the work.
sections.docs:
• Household income or qualifying benefit enrollment evidence.
  • Address and property information.
  • The local agency’s requested records and rental permissions.
sections.apply:
1. Find your agency

    Use the community action agency link on the IHWAP page.

  2. Complete local intake

    Ask about eligibility and the assessment process.

  3. Confirm approved work

    Arrange access and review what the provider has authorized.
sections.after: Keep the assessment, appointments and completed-work information. Ask the local agency about any safety condition preventing work.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using Illinois IHWAP requirements and measures. Agency staff determine eligibility.

faqs: Illinois lists recent LIHEAP participation as a categorical eligibility route.
Can I select an unrestricted renovation?
No. Approved weatherization and safety measures govern the work.
The state page identifies its current table as program year 2027.
Contact the community action agency serving your area.
